invariants.statement: Generic mouse and keyboard input remains independent of optional device-control applications.

A qualified native integration may submit exactly one fixed upstream Feature report through an opaque route; no application may submit arbitrary USB setup packets, sysfs operations, or receiver carrier frames.
One bridge is the sole userspace authority for receiver writes and one renewable lease owns each writable resource.
Every native exchange is bound to a live receiver generation, qualified opaque route, declarative report profile, NativeControl owner, deadline, and transaction identity.

Native availability is only available, temporarily-unavailable, or withdrawn; pairing, silence, and retail sleep or power labels never grant route authority. Only generation-bound explicit route evidence or endpoint-local traffic qualified by the receiver profile may produce available.
Unknown devices expose safe identity and passive observations but inherit no writable capability.
Receiver, child, and surface profiles compose independently; no exact mouse and keyboard pair is required.
Every queue, journal, event buffer, frame stream, message, and retry policy is explicitly bounded.
Only a complete correlated response is matched-response; a possible SET is may-have-been-sent and is never automatically repeated or reported as success.
Canonical schemas own shared facts; generated bindings and documentation may not drift from them.
Research code, raw captures, private identifiers, machine paths, and source-only physical qualification tools are not product dependencies.
No compile, test, package, tag, repository, or green workflow alone grants publication authorization.

must_not_own: application presentation, effects, profiles, or persistence

owns: native report shape and response matching
